name: Coral
note: UAE-based climate-tech company (carbon-emission management and blockchain carbon-credit offsetting); sustainability partner of Nissan Formula E Team since Season 10 (2023/24). Founded in 2022 by Juergen Hoebarth and Daniele Sileri; it closed a $3m seed round in September 2024 from undisclosed investors (Mubasher, english.mubasher.info/news/4346487). Ownership not traced. Official site coral.li (linked from the press kit's Related Links); its blog shows both founders still active in 2026. Distinct from Entain's UK betting brand Coral (coral.json).
